suspects.description: Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar4` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on an inner array field reached through a chained field path; the array decays to a pointer and `+ CONST` adds `CONST * sizeof(element)` bytes, matching the outer array stride. Replace `pCVar4->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk (two-step form) — `pCVar5` is advanced into scratch `pCVar3`, then rebound via a later `pCVar5 = pCVar3;`. Functionally identical to the single-line self-update; replace `pCVar5->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer and drop both the advance line and the rebind.
